summary: End-to-end testing of Obserra EIOS: 23 backend pytest cases against production URL (21 pass, 1 real failure = Stripe checkout 500, 1 test-ordering flake). Frontend flows validated with Playwright — login, dual-mode toggle, risk register, AI governance, recommendations/decisions, audit log, billing, and AI advisor SSE streaming all functional. Two issues to fix: (1) Stripe checkout 500 due to automatic_tax without a valid head office address, (2) minor test-id naming mismatch vs spec.

critical.issue: Returns 500: 'You must have a valid head office address to enable automatic tax calculation in test mode.' The Stripe test account is missing a head office address, but payments.py enables automatic_tax={'enabled': True}. Either disable automatic_tax or set the address on the Stripe test account. Frontend surfaces this as toast 'Could not start checkout'.

minor.issue: No validation on status values (any string accepted). Consider enum: sanctioned|shadow|deprecated.
DEC ref generated via count+1 is not concurrency-safe; two simultaneous decisions can collide. Consider ObjectId or Mongo counter.
EmailStr (pydantic email-validator) rejects .test / reserved TLDs (422). Not a functional bug but tests must use real-looking domains.

ui_bugs.issue: Description says 'Click any row for evidence lineage' but only the first (REF) cell has onClick — clicking anywhere else in the row does nothing. Move onClick to the <tr> or all td except the status dropdown.
'Could not start checkout' toast shown when Subscribe clicked — caused by backend 500 (Stripe automatic_tax config). No detail surfaced to user.

integration_issues.issue: Checkout session creation fails end-to-end; blocks the entire billing flow (success_url, /payment/status/{id} untested).

issues: Actual testids are nav-overview / nav-risk-register / nav-ai-governance / nav-recommendations / nav-audit-log / nav-billing. Spec listed nav-risks, nav-ai, nav-decisions — mismatch is minor but should be reconciled either in spec or NAV_ITEMS labels.

action_items: Fix Stripe checkout 500: either set automatic_tax={'enabled': False} in payments.create_checkout, or configure Stripe test-mode head office address at https://dashboard.stripe.com/test/settings/tax.
RiskRegister: make full <tr> row clickable for lineage (not just first cell) to match copy 'Click any row'.
Optional: align sidebar nav data-testids with spec (nav-risks / nav-ai / nav-decisions) or update spec.
critical_code_review_comments: payments.py: automatic_tax hard-enabled with no fallback — brittle to Stripe account config.
auth.py seed_admin correctly updates password if it changes ✓; bcrypt hash produced by bcrypt.hashpw ✓ ($2b$).
CORS: allow_credentials=True with explicit origin list ✓ (no wildcard with credentials).
ai_advisor.py: LLM errors are swallowed but 'done' still emitted — good UX, but should surface an error flag so frontend can show a real error state instead of silent empty response.
decide_rec DEC-ref generation uses count_documents+1 — race condition risk.
routes update endpoints don't enforce enum on status/risk_class — any string accepted.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (all pages render, all flows work except Stripe checkout)

seed_data_creation: Register endpoint auto-seeds a new org with 6 risks, 4 AI systems, 2 incidents, 2 recs, 1 decision — verified by tenant-isolation test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py is the pytest regression file. It creates orgs with @example.com emails. After the Stripe fix, re-run TestBilling::test_checkout_and_status. Note that the test that asserts a shadow AI (AI-003) exists will flake if any prior test sanctioned it — run isolated or reset DB.
rca of the issue: Stripe checkout: payments.py:75 sets automatic_tax={'enabled': True}. Stripe test account acct_1U1bU8AGTEe1D1HN has no head office address configured, so any session with automatic_tax raises InvalidRequestError → FastAPI returns 500. Fix option A (recommended for demo): remove automatic_tax kwarg. Fix option B (production-correct): set head office address in Stripe dashboard.
